title: Constant

eyebrow: Your Constant Fatigue Might Be an Underactive Thyroid

items.name: Low hormone slows the whole metabolism
Women, family history, over 60 at risk

closing.headline: Fatigue that rest doesn't fix, plus weight gain, cold, or constipation, is worth testing.
closing.tip: A simple TSH blood test can confirm an underactive thyroid.
closing.cta: Once diagnosed, one daily pill and follow-up blood tests keep the dose right.
